pages.text: Weigh your armor before you build a kit. Every piece is $(bold)robe$(), $(bold)light$(), $(bold)medium$(), or $(bold)heavy$(), and its class shifts your mana regen, speed, and armor.$(br2)Effects scale per piece worn, so a hybrid kit (two heavy, two light) lands proportionally between the extremes. Untagged armor counts as medium (no effect).

pages.title: Robe & Light
pages.text: $(5)Robe$() is true mage gear:$(li2)+0.10$() mana regen$(li2)+1.5%$() movement speed$(li2)-7.5%$() base armor$(li2)-10%$() armor toughness$(br2)$(t1)Light$() is rogue and agile cloth and leather:$(li2)+0.05$() mana regen$(li2)+5%$() movement speed$(li2)-5%$() base armor$(li2)-7.5%$() armor toughness

pages.title: Heavy
pages.text: $(t3)Heavy$() is diamond, netherite, and plate:$(li2)-0.05$() mana regen$(li2)-5%$() movement speed$(li2)+5%$() base armor$(br2)Medium (everything untagged) has no modifiers at all. It is the neutral baseline the other classes trade against.

pages.title: Robe Set Bonus
pages.text: $(bold)4 robe pieces$() unlock the $(5)True Mage$() set bonus, on top of the per-piece total:$(li2)+0.5$() mana regen$(br2)Final 4/4 robe totals:$(li2)+0.9$() mana regen$(li2)+6%$() speed$(li2)-30%$() armor$(li2)-40%$() toughness$(br2)The bonus rewards a pure caster build. Robes are the most fragile tier on purpose, so it has to be worth it.

pages.title: Full-Kit Extremes
pages.text: $(bold)4 robe$(): +0.9 mana, +6% speed, -30% armor, -40% toughness$(br)$(bold)4 light$(): +0.20 mana, +20% speed, -20% armor, -30% toughness$(br)$(bold)4 heavy$(): -0.20 mana, -20% speed, +20% armor, no toughness change$(br2)$(warn)Robes are doubly fragile.$() They lose toughness while heavy armor gains none, and diamond and netherite already have high native toughness, so the gap only widens.

pages.title: Robe & Light Gear
pages.text: $(5)Robe$(): Iron's Spellbooks class robes (Wizard, Pyromancer, Cryomancer, Electromancer, Cultist, Plagued, Priest, Wandering Magician, Archevoker, Netherite Battlemage), Botania manaweave, Terramity void mage + exodium warlock sets, and Iridescent Reforging mage majors (vestments).$(br)$(t1)Light$(): cloaks, hats, accessories, agile rogue gear (Shadow-Walker, pumpkin), and Iridescent Reforging light/scaled majors.

pages.title: Heavy Gear
pages.text: $(t3)Heavy$(): vanilla diamond and netherite, Aether obsidian, phoenix, valkyrie and gravitite, Aquaculture neptunium, Botania terrasteel, Cataclysm ignitium, Forbidden & Arcanus draco arcanus and tyr, Twilight Forest fiery and knightmetal, Undergarden froststeel and utherium, and more.

pages.title: Heavy Gear, cont.
pages.text: Everything else (vanilla iron and gold, mid-tier modded metals) is medium.$(br2)Reforged armor takes its class from the installed major module, whatever the material: a vestment crown counts as robe.

pages.title: Checking Your Totals
pages.text: Weight modifiers add up slot by slot and re-apply as soon as you swap a piece. They stack on top of base armor stats, Apotheosis affixes, and every other attribute source.$(br2)$(bold)Next: open your inventory ($(k:inventory)) and click Show Attributes.$() The armor, toughness, speed, and mana lines show what your current kit adds up to.
